apron: A protective piece of clothing worn over clothes while cooking.
balcony: A platform on the outside of a building above ground level.
biscuit: A small flat baked snack that is crisp or soft.
blossom: A flower on a tree or plant before fruit appears.
bucket: An open container with a handle used to carry liquids.
cactus: A desert plant with sharp spines that stores water.
chisel: A sharp hand tool used to cut or shape wood and stone.
coyote: A wild dog native to North America with a bushy tail.
cradle: A small bed for a baby that rocks from side to side.
crystal: A clear transparent mineral that forms natural geometric shapes.
dagger: A short knife with a pointed blade used as a weapon.
galaxy: A giant system of billions of stars held together in space.
garlic: A pungent plant bulb used to add flavor in cooking.
horizon: The line in the distance where the sky appears to meet land.

beacon: A bright light or signal that guides travelers or ships.
blanket: A warm fabric cover used on a bed to stay cozy.
canvas: A heavy woven cloth used for painting or making tents.
canyon: A deep narrow valley with steep stone sides.
castle: A large stone building built in history to protect royalty.
clover: A small green plant that typically has three rounded leaves.
donkey: A domesticated animal with long ears related to horses.
fossil: The preserved remains or mark of an ancient living thing.
goblet: A fancy cup with a stem and base used for drinking.
hammer: A hand tool with a heavy head used to drive nails.
harbor: A sheltered area of water where boats can park safely.
helmet: A hard hat worn to shield your head from impact.
island: A body of land surrounded entirely by water.
jacket: A short coat worn on the upper body for extra warmth.
kettle: A metal pot used to boil water for hot beverages.
lagoon: A shallow body of water separated from the sea by reefs.
lantern: A portable light source housed inside a clear case.
lizard: A small cold blooded reptile with four legs and a tail.
magnet: A piece of metal that attracts iron or steel objects.
meadow: A wide field covered with grass and wild flowers.
mirror: A glass surface that shows a clear reflection of objects.
museum: A place where historic or artistic objects are displayed.
needle: A thin metal pin with a small hole used for sewing.
orchard: A field planted with trees that produce fruit.
pebble: A small smooth rounded stone found near water.
planet: A large round object in space that orbits a star.
pocket: A small stitched pouch in clothing for holding items.
quiver: A case worn on the body used for carrying arrows.
rabbit: A small furry animal with long ears that hops.
rocket: A vehicle powered by powerful engines to reach space.
safari: An overland journey to view wild animals in nature.
statue: A sculpted figure of a person or animal made from stone.
trophy: A prize given to celebrate a victory or achievement.
walrus: A large arctic sea mammal with two long tusks.
whisper: To talk very quietly using soft breathy sounds.
zipper: A fastener with metal or plastic teeth used on clothes.
